CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection.
   C. Say Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
